method: Three separate-process runs per variant; seven batches of 5000 calls after 2000 warmups per shape. Order: base/binding/storage/combined, reverse, storage/base/combined/binding. Summary is median of process medians. Natural GC; async observations drained outside timed batches. No assistant-launched heavy jobs overlapped; unrelated machine load was uncontrolled. Profiles are separate whole-process runs of 301000 timed calls plus warmups and setup, not timing samples.
